action.title: Identifies if a record is to be upserted (inserted or updated) or (hard) deleted.

id.description: The unique identifier for the enrollment term.

key.title: Stores enrollment term records that describe the term or semester associated with courses (e.g. Fall 2013).
key.description:
Use the dates in this table as a proxy for the course start/end dates if the `start_at` and `end_at` fields in
the courses table are NULL.

integration_id.description: The ID of the enrollment term in the external tools or SIS, this ID usually gets populated via API or SIS import.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the enrollment term was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of when the enrollment term was last updated.

sis_batch_id.description: The unique identifier for the SIS import. This field is only included if the user has permission to manage SIS information.

start_at.description: The datetime of the start of the term. Set up by the administrator. Enrollment term dates, course dates, and course section dates flow together in all aspects of Canvas; various dates allow different users to participate in the course. The hierarchy of dates are: course section dates override course dates, course dates override term dates.

end_at.description: The datetime of the end of the term. Set up by the administrator.

sis_source_id.description: The SIS ID of the term. Only included if the user has permission to view SIS information.

term_code.description: Enrollment term code as viewed in the UI.

value.title: Stores enrollment term records that describe the term or semester associated with courses (e.g. Fall 2013).
value.description:
Use the dates in this table as a proxy for the course start/end dates if the `start_at` and `end_at` fields in
the courses table are NULL.
